name: Tallinn Central Library events calendar
what: Calendar of all branch events including free põnnihommik toddler mornings, lastehommik and reading sessions.

name: Tallinn Central Library children's page (Lasteleht)
what: Lists recurring children's clubs and toddler sessions by branch, plus the 'Born a Reader' programme.

name: huvi.tallinn.ee
what: City of Tallinn hobby and event database with children's classes and one-off family events, filterable by age.

name: Tallinn city events (tallinn.ee)
what: City event listings including Old Town Days family programmes and Museum Sundays (free first-Sunday museum entry).

name: Visit Tallinn – events
what: Official tourism listing of festivals, exhibitions and family attractions in English.

name: Kultuurikava
what: Nationwide culture calendar aggregating concerts, theatre and children's events, filterable by Tallinn.

name: Piletilevi – family (kogupere) category
what: Main ticketing site; family category lists children's theatre, puppet shows and attractions.

name: Fienta
what: Ticketing for smaller organisers, incl. the Opera's baby concerts and workshop-style family events.

name: Piletimaailm
what: Ticketing site where baby concerts (e.g. 'Kontsert kõige pisematele', baby ballet) are often sold.

name: Estonian National Opera tickets
what: Official tickets incl. 'Concert for the littlest' (0–3) and family performances.

name: Eesti Kontsert (concert.ee)
what: National concert organiser listing family and baby concerts in Estonia Concert Hall and elsewhere.

name: NUKU / Estonian Youth Theatre playbill
what: Playbill for the puppet theatre, tagging shows 'väikelapsele' (for small children) with age ratings.

name: Apollo Kino – Mum & Baby cinema day
what: Announces the next baby-friendly cinema mornings and films.

name: Kuhu minna lastega
what: Estonian blog/directory of where to go with kids, incl. cinema, theatre and weekend ideas.

name: Perekool forum
what: Large Estonian parenting forum where parents discuss baby concerts, classes and venues.
